label: monk2-s3
summary: The model approximates the MONK-2 rule (two attributes at their first value) with a tally and a veto. A direct additive tally rewards a1, a2, a3, a4 and a6 at their first value; node 419 switches on when three or more of those five are at their first value and pulls the prediction to no (switching it off lowers training AUC from 0.915 to 0.489); a small chain through nodes 1701 and 2480 shifts margins. The model's decision follows "two of a1, a2, a3, a4 and a6 at their first value, and a5 not at its first value" on 418 of the 432 input combinations, against 390 for the true target. Its main error is a5: the direct tally scores a5's first value against a yes, so for the 20 training rows where a5 and one other attribute are at their first value (all positive, outcome rate 100%) the mean predicted probability is 4.8e-05. Training accuracy 0.901, AUC 0.915.
